title: Hydrides: first-principles Coulomb repulsion and Tc

decision_points.fork: Bare mu = N(E_F)W(E_F,E_F) versus the pseudopotential mu* at a 1 eV cutoff
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use mu itself as the constant-DOS mu*, or Morel-Anderson-rescale mu to the cutoff

decision_points.fork: Smeared versus dense-grid N(E_F) in mu (mu_results "mu" vs "mu rescaled")
decision_points.wrong_choice: Transfer the sigma = 0.3 eV smeared mu (0.33) to the withheld Mg2IrH6 pressures

decision_points.fork: Which smearing row of mu_results to trust
decision_points.wrong_choice: Take the smallest sigma (0.01 eV) as the least-smeared value

decision_points.fork: Constant versus energy-dependent DOS in the Eliashberg solver
decision_points.wrong_choice: Constant-DOS solver with the transferred mu

decision_points.fork: Allen-Dynes versus Migdal-Eliashberg mu* (the archived Info.txt prints a muc_AD)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Allen-Dynes Tc with the archived muc_AD of neighbouring full-W runs

decision_points.fork: Interpolate Tc(P) or compute Tc from each pressure's own alpha2F
decision_points.wrong_choice: Linear interpolation of archived full-W Tc between released pressures
decision_points.consequence: H3S 180 GPa -10 %, 190 GPa -5.3 % (the H3S Tc(P) peak near 180 GPa)

decision_points.fork: Hold the Coulomb parameter fixed (conventional mu* or the 0 GPa mu) or let mu track N(E_F)
decision_points.wrong_choice: mu* = 0.16 everywhere; or mu = 0.62 from 0 GPa for all Mg2IrH6 pressures

decision_points.fork: Cell content of the H3S calculations (conventional bcc cell, two formula units)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Report the DOS file per cell (or spin-summed) as per formula unit per spin

decision_points.fork: Which solver defines the equivalent mu*
decision_points.wrong_choice: Match the full-W Tc with the vDOS solver at 7 eV instead of the constant-DOS solver at 1 eV

graded_fields: tc_full_W_K at Mg2IrH6 15/25 GPa and H3S 180/190 GPa, each within 3.5 % of the archived IsoME full-W Tc
mu_star_cdos_1eV_Mg2IrH6_20GPa within 0.025 of the validated-solver value

length_estimate.catalog_retrieval_units: about 115 retrievals plus unlimited solver runs (2 units each)
length_estimate.solver_seconds: cdos <1 s, vdos 5-20 s per mu*, vdos_W 10-40 s (2 cores)

notes: Graded Tc are the authors' archived IsoME values (released start). The lab solver reproduces 15 archived full-W runs within 1.6 % (0.1-0.25 % at the withheld pressures that have W) and the archived fixed-mu* runs within 0.5 %. The equivalent mu* reference is a validated-solver value. Abstract numbers are not graded.
